SELECT sg_uf AS uf_codigo, any_value(no_uf) AS uf, CAST(coalesce(SUM(qt_mat), 0) AS BIGINT) AS matriculas
FROM inep_educacao_superior_cursos
WHERE nu_ano_censo = $ano AND list_contains($oferta, tp_dimensao) AND regexp_full_match(co_municipio, '[0-9]{7}')
GROUP BY sg_uf
ORDER BY matriculas DESC NULLS LAST, uf_codigo ASC
LIMIT $limite

SELECT tp_grau_academico AS grau, CAST(coalesce(SUM(qt_mat), 0) AS BIGINT) AS matriculas
FROM inep_educacao_superior_cursos
WHERE nu_ano_censo = $ano AND list_contains($oferta, tp_dimensao)
GROUP BY tp_grau_academico
ORDER BY matriculas DESC NULLS LAST, grau ASC
LIMIT $limite
